name: Mastering AI 2027 (M.AI)
description: heise conference on developing and operating AI applications
note: on-site, German; formerly Minds Mastering Machines (m3-konferenz.de); team discount from 3 people
details:
Mastering AI (M.AI) is the renamed Minds Mastering Machines conference by heise/iX and dpunkt.verlag, subtitled "KI-Anwendungen entwickeln und betreiben".

Topics: agentic AI and MCP, GenAI and LLMs, optimizing AI applications, security for and with AI, data protection, data engineering and MLOps, experience reports. Audience: developers, architects, AI and data engineers. Prices only in the ticket shop.
